notes.title: Important Update on BUSTAFELLOWS save data issue
notes.content:
[h2][b]⚠️ Important Update Regarding Save Data ⚠️[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We have identified an issue that may cause save data loss for some players.[/p][p][/p][p]To protect your progress, this is a [b]mandatory update for ALL players[/b], not just those currently affected.[/p][p][/p][p][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Do [b]NOT[/b] launch BUSTAFELLOWS until you have carefully completed Steps 1–3! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Step 1:[/b] Update the game to the latest Update[/p][p][/p][p][b]Step 2:[/b] While logged in to Steam from a PC browser, access the following URL and download the save data. [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/account/remotestorage"]https://store.steampowered.com/account/remotestorage[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Step 3:[/b] In the Steam client app, right-click on the title “BUSTAFELLOWS”, then select Manage > Browse Local Files. This will open the installation folder for “BUSTAFELLOWS.” [/p][p]Inside the folder “BUSTAFELLOWS_Data\\StreamingAssets”, paste the file you just downloaded.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/613a6e83f001d25516b8eda144c6ddf632911a87.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Once steps 1–3 are complete, you can safely launch the game![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for updating and enjoy BUSTAFELLOWS ✨[/p][p]
Please note: This update cannot recover save data that has already been lost or overwritten. We sincerely apologise for any inconvenience this may have caused.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo now available!📣
notes.content:
[h1]🚨Exciting news!🚨
[/h1]

If you haven't played the gripping, thrilling, heart-pounding BUSTAFELLOWS yet, then now is the chance! We have released a demo version of the game, allowing you to step into the world of New Sieg and meet the wonderful, dashing cast.

Play as Teuta, the girl who can turn back time, as she risks it all to solve and rewrite the mystery of the charismatic, "crooked" lawyer, Limbo's, death.

Meet Shu the stoic hitman, Helvetica the masterful plastic surgeon, Mozu the autopsy specialist, and Scarecrow the [strike]self-proclaimed [/strike]boss of the underworld.

What's best is they are all romanceable! Fight crimes and find love, what better combination visual novel can you ask for?

So what are you waiting for? Go check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/c3d519a934ee791da5b63b98be8598399e03f09e.png[/img]

notes.title: Steamy Noir Visual Novel 'BUSTAFELLOWS' Reveals 30th July, 2021
notes.content:
We are excited to reveal that BUSTAFELLOWS will be [b]launching on Steam on 30th July, 2021! [/b]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/102e0c170809e468683193852b42e654c24f106b.png[/img]


[list]
[*] Over 80 hours of gameplay, localised for the first time
[*] Murder, mystery, and dangerous relationships with unique interactive narrative gameplay
[*] Solve crimes, puzzles and more to unravel the truth
[*] Romance 5 dangerous fellows
[*] Unlockable side stories & multiple endings
[*] Cameo appearances from the cast of 'Side Kicks!'
[*] Complete Japanese voice acting, including KENN, Yoshimasa Hosoya & more
[*] Launching on Steam 30th July, 2021
[/list]
 
As an otome title, a genre known for its female leads and romantic subplots, step into the shoes of a strong, smart, and gifted journalist embroiled in a life and death adventure. With the ability to jump back in time, and into the bodies of others,[b] collect clues, press witnesses and protect your friends in this thrilling noir visual novel![/b]
 
Check out BUSTAFELLOWS' trailer: 
[previewyoutube=T9ySJy2bqvU;full]https://youtu.be/T9ySJy2bqvU[/previewyoutube]


🌹 [b]With romance, mystery, and dangerous relationships,[/b] BUSTAFELLOWS follows our heroine, Teuta, a young, independent journalist on a mission to maintain order and justice after the harrowing murder of her brother years ago.
 
😍 [b]Become embroiled in a thrilling plot about love, loss, fear, and fortune as you strive to save the life of your friends.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/a5844db65649b652fa301bf923e54db1f2f8405d.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/61bdac4f21febcc703a91f3e8ef468b4d6cf80f5.png[/img]

📝[b]Use your trusty notepad to record clues and key pieces of information, solve critical puzzles and navigate complex relationships[/b] as you journey into this interactive mystery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/cf71144604780a32546772db3dd0e80016e0a112.png[/img]

Every decision matters -
🔓 [b]unlock multiple endings and side missions with every choice you make.[/b] Will all routes lead to romance? Can you save your friends?
 
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⌛Only time will tell...
⠀
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/19f9319bb7166cd02844610a214196d1bfae4193.jpg[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/1cd1dfc231459dcad30bdab279ebe236a25e21ab.png[/img]

As an otome visual novel, a genre known for its female heroines and multiple romantic options, take the lead and control your own destiny in BUSTAFELLOWS.
 
[b]Romance 5 dangerous ikemen from crooked lawyers to hitmen and more[/b], unfurling this mysterious and secretive backstories as you develop your bond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/69e5d212a2f654c80029249fc4b4f9585f11b444.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steam Collectors Edition - available for pre-purchase now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/c3d519a934ee791da5b63b98be8598399e03f09e.png[/img]

Following the fantastic reception to its 2019 launch in Japan, BUSTAFELLOWS has been one of the most highly anticipated visual novels to be brought to the West.
 
With a fully voiced protagonist and featuring many renowned voice actors recognisable from Final Fantasy, League of Legends and more, step into the shoes of a strong, smart, and gifted journalist embroiled in a life and death adventure in this thrilling visual novel.

[h3][b]Today we are pleased to announce the BUSTAFELLOW's Collections Edition box, [url=https://funstock.co.uk/products/bustafellows-collectors-edition-pc-steam]available for pre-purchase now[/url]![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/9bfbd510015a33156c9c144f14210829986beb31.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/a64777240563cdda03db9c8db6e3768f736346eb.jpg[/img]

[h3][u][b]'New Sieg People Weekly' Magazine[/b][/u][/h3]
Originally launched in Japan only, BUSTAFELLOWS received critical acclaim leading to the highly coveted status of its limited run collector's edition. Now, players in the west will have the opportunity to grab an abridged version of 'New Sieg People Weekly' magazine as featured in the original Japanese collector's edition once again.
 
Featuring original sketches, unique art and character profiles, the magazine has been localised to English and offers an intimate behind the scenes glimpse at the development of BUSTAFELLOWS and its captivating cast of characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/c744e368ec5c801512091c883184815c50e4ad57.jpg[/img]

[h3][u][b]Scarecrow Mixtape
[/b][/u][/h3] 
Scarecrow's Mixtape CD features 27 tracks from the BUSTAFELLOWS soundtrack. Recorded in Scarecrow's secret studio, the mix includes 'Novalis', 'Come and Get Me', and many more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/c7d259642188f40f0bc2faa562e960a71caea873.jpg[/img]

[h3][u][b]6 Art Cards
[/b][/u][/h3] 
With stunning character and environmental art from renowned artist Sumeragi Kohaku, the BUSTAFELLOWS Collectors Edition includes 6 unique and dynamic art cards featuring the whole cast.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/6859483238b7060cfd7b294b277d9bfcd81e99ff.jpg[/img]

[h3]BUSTAFELLOWS Collector's Edition is available for pre-order on the [url=https://funstock.co.uk/products/bustafellows-collectors-edition-pc-steam]Funstock Store[/url] from today![/h3]
